findings.title: Proceeds from Disposals has no plan data
findings.detail: Referenced by Cash Flow from Investing Activities but evaluates to 0 in every version.
findings.prompt: Proceeds from Disposals (cf-disposals) has no data. Should it stay in the Cash Flow from Investing Activities formula, and how should it be planned (driver, % of another line, or ML forecast)?

findings.title: Add Programme & Production Costs % of Revenue
findings.detail: Programme & Production Costs has no ratio KPI — common in EPM reporting packs.
findings.prompt: Add a new KPI "Programme & Production Costs % of Revenue" = cogs / rev * 100.

findings.title: Gross Revenue (Advertising, Distribution, Production, Other) moved EUR -3.95B vs Budget
findings.detail: Largest 9+3 Forecast vs Budget movement among P&L inputs.
findings.prompt: Explain the EUR -3.95B movement in Gross Revenue (Advertising, Distribution, Production, Other) between Budget and 9+3 Forecast and its impact through to EBITDA and Net Income.
